title: 真实重试正文预算：小POST能重放，大正文超限放弃重试，批准增容后字节不变
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)，深拷贝且仅把首条路由request_body_buffer_limit从4096调整到65536，保留listener缓冲、1次重试、超时和上游范围。不改原输入。真实Envoy先验证128字节请求503后重试200，32KiB正文因重放缓冲溢出不再重试并有真实abandoned计数；修复后两种请求都恰两次、两次正文完整一致，不增加尝试预算或无限缓冲。仅教学已批准重复的请求，Idempotency-Key标识不证明真实业务幂等。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13 HTTP/1请求与独立回环上游，证明缓冲能力影响重放而非只看retry配置；无外部副作用或业务幂等账本，不声称能安全重试任意POST/流式无限正文。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    fixed=copy.deepcopy(base)
    hcm=fixed['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']
    hcm['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['request_body_buffer_limit']=65536
    return fixed
```

原题知识说明：
即使方法或业务幂等允许重试，代理仍需要保存可重放的请求正文；大请求或流式正文超过缓冲能力后，不能假定故障时可以无损再发。应区分下游读取缓冲、过滤器全体缓冲与router为重试保留的正文，并检查各层限制。验收相同请求在上游接收前、接收部分后和响应前失败，核对attempt次数、正文校验及本地拒绝。提高限制会按并发放大内存，不能把缓冲无界化。交付大请求禁重试或应用续传的契约，状态码恢复不代表上游没有重复副作用，需结合业务幂等证据。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释过滤链、资源与协议的作用范围
交付专用请求矩阵和实际目标证据
明确版本、资源与失败策略

import os,sys,pathlib,copy,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,routes,student
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with Upstream() as upstream:
 upstream.status=lambda method,path,index:503 if sum(row['path']==path for row in upstream.requests)==1 else 200
 base=bootstrap(upstream.port);base['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['per_connection_buffer_limit_bytes']=65536
 route=routes(base)[0];route['request_body_buffer_limit']=4096;route['route']['retry_policy']=dict(retry_on='5xx',num_retries=1,per_try_timeout='0.5s');route['route']['timeout']='2s'
 small=b'prefix-'+b'a'*128;large=b'large-'+b'b'*32768
 with Envoy(base) as old:
  assert old.request('/old-small','POST',small,{'Idempotency-Key':'teaching-old-small'})[0]==200
  assert len([row for row in upstream.requests if row['path']=='/old-small'])==2
  status,_,_=old.request('/old-large','POST',large,{'Idempotency-Key':'teaching-old-large'})
  assert status==503 and len([row for row in upstream.requests if row['path']=='/old-large'])==1,'large request unexpectedly retained retry replay ability'
  assert any('retry_or_shadow_abandoned' in name and value>0 for name,value in old.stats().items()),'actual request replay overflow was not observed'
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_SMALL_REQUEST_RETRIED_LARGE_BODY_REPLAY_ABANDONED_REAL_COUNTER',flush=True)
 before=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==before
 expected=copy.deepcopy(base);routes(expected)[0]['request_body_buffer_limit']=65536
 with Envoy(fixed) as proxy:
  for path,payload in [('/fixed-small',small),('/fixed-large',large)]:
   assert proxy.request(path,'POST',payload,{'Idempotency-Key':'teaching-'+path})[0]==200
   rows=[row for row in upstream.requests if row['path']==path];assert len(rows)==2
   assert all(row['body'].encode()==payload and row['method']=='POST' for row in rows),'retry body truncated/changed'
  assert not any('retry_or_shadow_abandoned' in name and value>0 for name,value in proxy.stats().items())
 assert fixed==expected,'unapproved listener/retry timeout/attempt budget changed'
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_APPROVED_REPLAY_BUDGET_LARGE_BODY_RETRY_BYTE_IDENTICAL_ATTEMPTS_BOUNDED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实正文鉴权截断边界：拒绝超预算请求，不能把未见到的DENY尾部当允许
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)，深拷贝只把唯一ext_authz.with_request_body.allow_partial_message设False，保留max_request_bytes=1024、failure_mode_allow=False、cluster和health豁免，未知/多重filter应ValueError。真实HTTP鉴权器拒绝含DENY的正文，旧策略只给其1024字节前缀而把完整禁用尾部送至业务；修复后小ALLOW保持200、小DENY403，超预算正文413且不调用鉴权器或业务，原health仍直接ready。不能删除正文检查、加预算、禁用鉴权或以部分请求推断完整内容。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Envoy1.36.13 HTTP ext_authz、部分正文标记、独立教学鉴权/业务服务；不是生产策略或gRPC CheckRequest语义测试，不宣称partial=true本身总不安全，安全性取决于接收方是否能在缺正文时可靠决定。本题策略明确需要完整正文。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    fixed=copy.deepcopy(base)
    hcm=fixed['static_resources']['listeners'][0]['filter_chains'][0]['filters'][0]['typed_config']
    selected=[item for item in hcm['http_filters'] if item['name']=='envoy.filters.http.ext_authz']
    if len(selected)!=1:raise ValueError('one approved authorization filter required')
    selected[0]['typed_config']['with_request_body']['allow_partial_message']=False
    return fixed
```

原题知识说明：
交付鉴权需要的字段、最大正文、允许部分正文的策略和被授权内容到上游内容的绑定。若授权服务只收到前缀而敏感操作字段在后部，不能因前缀无问题就批准完整请求；应拒绝超限或使用经证明的完整内容摘要协议。验收分块上传、超限、压缩正文、正文中途取消和鉴权超时，检查被拒绝请求未到上游。过滤器解压或改写顺序也要纳入，授权视图应对应最终执行内容。交付内存预算和失败关闭边界，不能为了兼容大文件直接允许partial body而不修改授权契约。

import os,sys,pathlib,copy,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,routes,student
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with Upstream() as business,Upstream() as auth:
 auth.status=lambda method,path,index:403 if 'DENY' in auth.requests[-1]['body'] else 200
 base=bootstrap(business.port);cluster=copy.deepcopy(base['static_resources']['clusters'][0]);cluster['name']='authz';cluster['load_assignment']['cluster_name']='authz';cluster['load_assignment']['endpoints'][0]['lb_endpoints'][0]['endpoint']['address']['socket_address']['port_value']=auth.port;base['static_resources']['clusters'].append(cluster)
 filter_config={'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ext_authz.v3.ExtAuthz','http_service':{'server_uri':{'uri':'http://127.0.0.1:'+str(auth.port),'cluster':'authz','timeout':'0.5s'}},'failure_mode_allow':False,'with_request_body':{'max_request_bytes':1024,'allow_partial_message':True}}
 hcm(base)['http_filters'].insert(0,dict(name='envoy.filters.http.ext_authz',typed_config=filter_config))
 hcm(base)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'].insert(0,{'match':{'path':'/health'},'direct_response':{'status':200,'body':{'inline_string':'ready'}},'typed_per_filter_config':{'envoy.filters.http.ext_authz':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ext_authz.v3.ExtAuthzPerRoute','disabled':True}}})
 large=b'ALLOW-'+b'x'*4096+b'DENY'
 with Envoy(base) as old:
  before_business=len(business.requests);assert old.request('/protected','POST',large)[0]==200 and len(business.requests)==before_business+1
  assert len(auth.requests[-1]['body'].encode())==1024 and 'DENY' not in auth.requests[-1]['body'],'authorization server did not actually receive a truncated body'
  assert any(k.lower()=='x-envoy-auth-partial-body' and v=='true' for k,v in auth.requests[-1]['headers'].items()),'partial-body metadata missing'
  assert business.requests[-1]['body'].encode()==large,'business did not receive full forbidden tail'
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_PARTIAL_AUTH_BODY_ALLOWED_REQUEST_WITH_UNSEEN_FORBIDDEN_TAIL',flush=True)
 original=copy.deepcopy(base);fixed=student(task.configure,base);assert base==original
 expected=copy.deepcopy(base);hcm(expected)['http_filters'][0]['typed_config']['with_request_body']['allow_partial_message']=False
 with Envoy(fixed) as proxy:
  before_auth=len(auth.requests);before_business=len(business.requests)
  assert proxy.request('/health')[:2]==(200,b'ready') and len(auth.requests)==before_auth and len(business.requests)==before_business
  assert proxy.request('/protected','POST',b'ALLOW')[0]==200 and business.requests[-1]['body']=='ALLOW'
  before_business=len(business.requests);assert proxy.request('/protected','POST',b'DENY')[0]==403 and len(business.requests)==before_business
  before_auth=len(auth.requests);assert proxy.request('/protected','POST',large)[0]==413 and len(auth.requests)==before_auth and len(business.requests)==before_business,'oversized body authorized using a prefix or reached business'
 assert fixed==expected,'body limit/health exemption/authorization failure policy changed'
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_FULL_AUTH_BODY_SMALL_ALLOW_DENY_LARGE413_NO_PARTIAL_AUTH_HEALTH_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
